description: One plan for launching a wellness product in Australia: the regulatory pathway it is likely on (medicine, food or cosmetic), the five steps from brief to shelf (Discover, Design, De-risk, Deliver, Drive) with what each step delivers and what the brand decides, how long comparable launches took and what could slow this one, the TGA's fees for a first listing when it is a medicine, the closest case studies, and the call. Runs the pathway check, the timeline and the fees tool together, so every figure and rule is quoted from takefridayoff.com with its link. Pass what is known; the answer says what it assumed. Not legal or regulatory advice, and not a quote.

channel.description: Where it will sell: direct_to_consumer, pharmacy_and_health_food, or both (for the margin that cost of goods leaves)

claims.description: What the brand wants to say it does: treat_or_prevent_condition (prevents, cures or relieves a disease, condition or symptom), health_benefit (supports a body function or health: immunity, energy, sleep, joints), beauty_or_appearance (skin, hair, nails, looks), sports_performance, nutrition (protein, energy, vitamins as nutrition), sun_protection (an SPF), acne, hair_growth, cleanse_or_fragrance

formula_proven.description: The formula has already been proven in samples and trials

ingredients.description: Notable ingredients: poisons_standard_substance (in Schedule 2, 3, 4 or 8), sports_declared_substance (an added substance on the 2023 World Anti-Doping Prohibited List, dendrobium, methylliberine or something with the same action), hmb (isolated HMB or its salts), shark_cartilage, fibre, herbal_extract

lip_or_tinted_foundation.description: A lip product or a tinted foundation (these have their own sunscreen exclusion)

made_overseas.description: The product will be made outside Australia

meets_sports_food_standard.description: Made and labelled as a formulated supplementary sports food under Standard 2.9.4

new_ingredient.description: An ingredient not yet on the TGA's Permissible Ingredients Determination, so it needs its own evaluation first

primary_sunscreen.description: Presented mainly to protect the skin from UV

product.description: The product in a sentence: "collagen powder for glowing skin", "magnesium gummies for sleep", "SPF 30 tinted moisturiser"

retail_price.description: The planned retail price in Australian dollars, for the target cost of goods and a first-run budget

spf.description: The SPF, for a product applied to the skin

traditional_food.description: Has a tradition of use as a food in Australia or New Zealand, in the form presented

use.description: Swallowed, or applied to the skin or hair

name: tfo_launch_plan
title: Plan a product launch
